homepage_reported.evidence: Homepage visible text says 280 mechanics and 28 mechanic groups; og:image:alt says 280 mechanics across 28 systems. The non-JavaScript homepage only renders a featured sample, so it is not the denominator.

differences.summary: index.json cases omit implementation, source, rights and observation fields present in catalog.json. All 280 indexed mechanics differ there; identity fields match.

index.json prototype keeps scope and interaction only. catalog.json also carries editorial firstStep, pitfall and test text for all 280 mechanics. Those editorial strings are not copied into the notes.
The homepage without JavaScript exposes featured mechanics, not the full public list. The denominator comes from the reconciled sitemap, index, catalog and per-mechanic documents.

These source ids keep a historical slug prefix that is not their system id: allocation-savings-interest, allocation-shop-reservation, exploration-air-action-refill, exploration-climbing-rest-route, exploration-gliding-descent, exploration-grapple-swing, exploration-stealth-awareness, exploration-wall-jump.
